decisions.reason: The blanket SI assignment to generalized coordinates is false: a dimensionless angle has an action-valued conjugate. Replaced it by the cotangent rule that p_i dq^i has units J s, retaining length coordinates and the separate mechanical-momentum assumption. The model flow and preparation remain unchanged.

The shell hypotheses control H inverse J only; the original quantifier over every nonempty shell did not require E in J, so F7 could not establish its claimed mass and invariance. Restored the supplier exact energy range E in J and n>=1. Also supplied the missing chartwise measure-preservation bridge on open flow domains before restriction to arbitrary invariant Borel R; the weighted clause remains unchanged.

The supplied implication applies to exactly the same probability-preserving map and absolute-Cesaro convention. For strictly invariant E every correlation with E equals mu(E)(1-mu(E)), so weak mixing forces mass zero or one. Reusing this valid argument is not a mathematical defect; no distinct-proof obligation occurs in the approved statement. Item unchanged.

The invoked canonical clause of the invariant-measure supplier has no full-AC hypothesis; its separate shell clause is unused. Removed the full-AC dependency and corrected A1 to countable choice for the phase measure and Fubini. On open complete R the density-preserving lemma applies directly. Normalization, weak transport, smooth Liouville equation and absolutely integrable fine entropy follow with the original Statement unchanged.

The fine-entropy supplier assumes an open complete invariant domain and normalized Borel L1 data, with no regular-shell premise. Corrected A1 and removed unnecessary full AC. Also defined reversibility by an anti-symplectic involution and verified J(theta,I)=(-theta,I) reverses the flow and preserves R. Exact cell laws (1,0),(1/2,1/2),(0,1) give coarse entropies 0,k log 2,0, while the absolute fine-entropy integral is log 4. The refuted assertion is unchanged.
